headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.7975). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 8 studies yielded an effect size of 1.08 (95% CI: 0.68–1.72), indicating no statistically significant association between omega-3_fatty_acids and uterine cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 97.51%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
